post.title: Why a probe of Nvidia's CEO touches your S&P 500 fund
post.ig:
Nearly 8 cents of every S&P 500 fund dollar is Nvidia.
Sunday, Nov 8: Nvidia's board opened an independent probe into reports CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign spy effort.
The board says it sees no sign secrets were compromised; Huang stays CEO.
Shares slid roughly 5% premarket Monday. Our math: that's about 0.4% off an S&P 500 fund if nothing else moves.
Next: earnings Nov 17.
Sources: Nvidia board statement, CNBC, Bloomberg, Dow Jones.
News and education, not financial advice.
